notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.notes:
Today we have released a free Halloween bonus place.
 
It's our gift to our fantastic audience.  We are so very grateful for all the support and interest in our games.
 
The feedback so far has been tremendously positive.  It has been so nice to hear about how much the game has been an uplifting and relaxing experience for so many.  It brightens our day as well to know our cat games have done some good.
 
Many thanks also to the players who have patiently worked with us to fix bugs and improve the game for everyone.  It has been a real pleasure working with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41739106/69fec07e90e184315209983c53c567fbf54d2218.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41739106/87d34ea3659054d8d8f27a433cff05dc4506520b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41739106/f2a22b45d84f80f12d610c2f88b5af9ab36bba42.png
 
So enjoy the Halloween mood of our new holiday place.  
 
As with the main game, the content is appropriate for all ages.  Nothing ghostly or ghastly happening to our cats.  They're just having a good time, we hope you will join them in their festivities.
 
 
Patch Notes

 Halloween place added.
 New main menu for the month.
 Added a Replay button after clearing a place.

notes.title: Version 2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This version ports the game to the most up to date build of our framework.  This will fix a handful of issues encountered by players that have been addressed in ESC 3.

Let us know if any new issues have appeared.

FIXES

 Fixed an issue with game freezing at startup.
 Fix a display quality issue on monitors that use upscaling.
 Fixed achievement check for unique cat totals when game starts.

notes.title: Version 1.8 Patch Notes and ESC3 Demo
notes.notes:
FEATURES

Can now zoom out fully.
Zoom is now also saved and restored when continuing a game.
Added alerts about data problems, and options to restore data.


FIXES

Fixed a bug with save file data loss.
Fixed a bug where continue option can be lost.
Fixed a minor issue with reporting best times when none exist.


New Demo

Also we have released a demo for our next game.  Download now to play three new fairy tale themed places!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2156420/

notes.title: Version 1.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Compatability Updates


Increased graphics compatibility a small amount.  This may resolve some graphics card driver issues for some players.
The game is now available as 32-bit and 64-bit.  Steam will download the version that fits your system.

Let us know in our Tech Support forum if this release is causing any new issues.

notes.title: Version 1.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
FEATURES

Added mouse wheel zooming.  Roll the wheel to zoom in and out, press the wheel to reset zoom.
Options added to disable zoom, or change the zoom type and its speed.
A "How to Play" panel has been added.  It will display once, and can be revisited in the options.

notes.title: News and Version 1.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
NEWS

Ever Seen a Cat? 2 release date set to May 30th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972710/Ever_Seen_A_Cat_2/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41739106/4ac08d8501662dbcf9bca85515547f63cc666864.png

PATCH NOTES

FEATURES

Hint button added.
Best time information added.

FIXES

Fixed sound effect flickering in the Place selection screen.
Fixed when music tracks failing to shuffle when continuing games.
Fixed recounts of cat totals and time, when continuing a completed place.
Adjusted background vignettes to make edge cats easier to see.
Adjusted image quality of some backgrounds.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41739106/e8e214862a6d70c9d5a1682bbf83f05cbaa43a30.png

HINTS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41739106/5d659577fdb2d4d6b48f117443775a20449f365a.jpg

After two minutes a hint button will become active.  Using it will cause cats to purr with visual and audio indicators.  This is activated with a new button next to the cat counter.  After its first use, it can be reused every 30 seconds.


BEST TIMES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41739106/fb341a121dc563edc0435085bd03079c2df4f689.jpg

More information about best times can be seen in the score screen.  It shows your best time, or previous best when achieving a new record.

notes.title: Version 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
FEATURES

Added a COLOR option to change the background color.
Added a VIBRANCE option to dim or brighten the background color.
Added a reset button to all settings with sliders in the options panel.

notes.title: Version 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
FEATURES

The current music track is saved with the current game and will resume when choosing to continue.
Game will now automatically pause and resume when leaving and entering the game window.


FIXES

Fixed an issue with option to limit frame rate.
Fixed a bug with continuing saved games if they were made when quitting from the victory screen.

notes.title: Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
FIXES

 Fixed camera position bug when entering Town place.
 Fixed main screen getting stuck when entering places from options menu.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
FEATURES

 Added a frame rate limit setting in the options.  Default: 60 FPS


FIXES

 Fixed incorrect default settings when first launching the game.
 Fixed an an accuracy bug with the unique cat found total that is displayed in the first clear message.
 Improved the achievement descriptions for finding all individual / unique cats in a place.
